tagline: Beneath Donato's weather-beaten exterior lies a mind as sharp as any merchant prince's, though cloak
bio: Donato Fabbro stands as a testament to how far determination and physical prowess can elevate a man in Venice's rigid social hierarchy. Once a common dock worker like his forebears, Donato transformed his position as a facchino into an enterprise that commands both respect and suspicion across the Rialto.
